Music Artist Website Requirements:
- Hero section with logo/text animation + timing controls
- Two-column layout: tour agenda (left) + bio (right)  
- Gallery section supporting images/videos (all formats)
- Social links (Instagram, Facebook) + contact form
- Full background control per section: color pickers, gradients, image/video uploads with positioning controls
- Hero section needs 5-second intro animation with background fade/overlay timing
- Goal: 60-90 minutes full build (frontend + backend)
- Repeatability for future sites with customization options
- Maximum speed development with professional results

memories.content:
FINAL TECH STACK DECISION:
- Next.js 14 (App Router) for framework
- Payload CMS for content management (code-first, fast setup)
- ShadCN/UI + Radix UI for components
- Framer Motion for animations (not GSAP - better React integration)
- Cloudinary for media handling
- PostgreSQL + Prisma for database
- Vercel deployment with integrated database
- Realistic timeline: 95-125 minutes (not 60-90)

KEY SUCCESS FACTORS:
1. Build component library first
2. Use pre-configured Payload field groups
3. Leverage Framer Motion timeline features
4. Mobile testing throughout
